text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened right after the Japan Cup had ended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Told that there was somewhere she wanted me to go with her,
the place we arrived at was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was Nakayama Racecourse on a weekday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, there's nooo-body here!
It's so quiet and lonely, feels weird!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for asking them to let me in!
I just had to see it for myself at least once!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Just—watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelouuus!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A faint, distant echo came returning back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An empty racetrack.
Naturally, there is no one else to answer—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —See, this is what I can do all on my own!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Did it reach the Trainer who was right beside me?
Did it truly resonate with them?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Going far away is tough enough!
Around the entire world—is way tougher!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
My dream, the 'World Marvelous Project',
is hard to make come true all on my own!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: But guess what?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, Laurel, Brian, Fuji...
So many girls accepted
my Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Everyone took that Marvelous,
nurtured it within themselves,
and made it into an even bigger Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Feeling that marvelous filled me
with an even bigger and stronger marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Next time, even farther! Even, even stronger!
I can deliver the Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you get it? This is
the final key to the "Project Marvelous World"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: If it spreads, connects, and grows bigger! That marvelousness will surely, absolutely――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I will embrace the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while reeling from the shock, I realized she was right.
Ever since the Tenno Sho (Spring), her running—her very will—had grown ever more dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that is because none other than the rivals running alongside her had imparted an even stronger light to her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Thinking that far ahead, a smile naturally spread across my face.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Wait, wait, Trainer?
Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apologizing for puzzling them, I continued speaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Running alongside rivals who have become Marvelous, delivering a Marvelous that has grown grander and stronger.’
If that is indeed the final key――"
choice_data_list: Then your dream will come true soon, Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Really!?
But, but, why...at all!?
choice_data_list: Because you have always stayed true to who you are.
It's because you've always been yourself

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous is spreading across the world, ready to burst forth at any moment.
And yet, she is always right at the center of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: You're okay, the finish line is right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right in front of us? How can you be so sure?
Why, why, why?!
choice_data_list: Come tomorrow, you'll understand the reason too
Come tomorrow, you'll understand the reason too

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, accompanied by Marvelous Sunday,
I arrived at the press conference venue—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Is everyone here?
Well then, without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We will now begin the press conference for the Arima Kinen runners!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, Trainer?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Incredible, incredible, incredible!!
How!? Just how much did you know!?
Don't tell me... you knew the whole thing!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because, because, because, like this is—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday can't hide her shock and excitement.
Directly in her line of sight is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yup, Sakura Laurel here!
...I'm home, Mave-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I ran my heart out overseas, trained hard—and came back stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So let's run in the Arima Kinen!
With who I am right now—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even more than that 'Tenno Sho (Spring)',
way, way more!
I'll show you an even more wonderful Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait! I've been getting stronger too, you know! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The fruits of my mountain training!
I'm gonna show 'em off completely and utterly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Brian-san♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't care. Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'm just here to enjoy myself.
With these legs... I will devour everything.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel, Mayano, Brian...!
Amazing, so amazing,
are all of you running in the Arima Kinen...!?

Whoa there!
Don't go thinking it's over just yet!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah! W-W-W-Wah!
Hishi Amaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Count me in too, Marvelous!
With a one-on-one showdown this hyped up,
just watching would be so boring!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, hold on, hold on!
What kind of all-star lineup is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
No way, this is just...! I'm getting
way too hyped for the Arima Kinen,
I think I'm gonna explode...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the press conference for the Arima Kinen
concluded on a note of tremendous excitement...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahaha, ahahahaha...☆
The Arima Kinen was so marvelouuus...★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Marvelous Sunday,
perhaps she got too carried away, because
she's been like this for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth, word about the press conference
and who would be participating
had reached me a bit earlier."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, keeping quiet until the day of the event
was to deliver a 'pleasant surprise'—in other words,
something 'Marvelous' to her, though."
choice_data_list: (Did I take it a bit too far...?)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's totally not true~~~...☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —No no no no nooo waaaay☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!!
Thank you so much!! MAAARVELOUS!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "The marvelous from you, Trainer, is burning bright in my heart too."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So keep watching!!
Get hyped, look forward to it!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen!
We're gonna change the world!!
